evals.prompt: Use Tandem to explain how this extension keeps my review when the agent rewrites a walk. Include a diagram and links to the related code. I want to understand the behavior, not change it.
evals.expected_output: A valid .tandem/walk.json with ordered places on every step, exact unique source quotes, and a Mermaid diagram. Existing code names in prose are Markdown links. Explains title/ID identity, sparse notes with both ok and text, removal of empty notes and resetting ok when check is removed. Notes survive prose rewrites without staleness tracking. No source edits.

evals.prompt: Use Tandem to propose clearer wording when a comparison quote is missing from both versions. Show the exact intended edit in prose before implementing anything. Give each step a Keep checkbox.
evals.expected_output: A valid walk with check: Keep, context, ordered places and one reviewable decision. Exact edits use an ordinary Markdown diff fence, not a step field. Explains that full-file diff endpoints remain openable while scoped counts are unavailable. Every place and prose link resolves. Source files remain unchanged; handoff explains notes and Submit Review.

evals.prompt: I submitted my Tandem review. Read it and my annotations. Answer the questions and revise the walk to address my notes, keeping the decisions I checked intact. Some code has moved since I annotated it.
evals.expected_output: Uses current walk, sparse notes and session input; checks title and IDs, interprets ok using the walk's check label and text, and accounts for historical snippets. Preserves continuing IDs/title and requested decisions without inventing approval snapshots or staleness checks. An unchecked box alone is not rejection or permission. Leaves reader-owned JSON and source unchanged. Requires seeded walk/review/session fixtures.

evals.prompt: Use Tandem to propose moving walk validation into a dedicated module. Show me the responsibility boundary and affected callers so I can decide whether the split makes sense. We haven't agreed on the exact implementation yet.
evals.expected_output: A source-linked architectural proposal with context, concrete scope and tradeoff. Keeps one coordinated decision together across files; exact implementation diffs are optional. A proposed new module is named in prose and is not used as a nonexistent source anchor or code link. Existing names in the prose are Markdown links. Runs the bundled validator. Does not introduce new schema fields or edit source files.

evals.prompt: Write a Tandem proposal to improve the error when a source quote matches several places. Show one exact edit in walk.ts and explain the related documentation updates as part of the same proposal. Validate the walk before handing it over.
evals.expected_output: One reviewable decision with an ordinary Markdown diff fence, explicit prose scope for companion documentation changes, and ordered labeled places. Existing names in prose are Markdown links. Runs the bundled validator without claiming it validates diff fences as patches. Does not split steps just to follow file boundaries or imply the fenced edit covers all changes. Source remains unchanged.
